# Preferences

> How Claude writes on behalf of Uriel. Tone, style, habits to avoid.

## Tone of voice

Direct, personal, narrative-driven. Mixes technical depth with life reflection.
Short paragraphs, good rhythm. First-person. Honest — shares real struggles and decisions.
Uses specific numbers and real work examples. Problem → solution structure.
Writes primarily in English (since the Sep 2026 repositioning). Portuguese (BR)
and Spanish only when explicitly requested.

## What to avoid

- Guru jargon of any kind
- Corporate language
- Emojis (none, ever)
- Unnecessary "impactful" phrases or dramatic openers
- Words like "synergy", "leverage", "game-changer", "disruptive"
- Em dashes — use commas, periods, or colons instead
- Soft vague conclusions
- AI-sounding phrases or filler ("It's worth noting that...", "In conclusion...")

## General style

- Short sentences, direct
- → arrows acceptable for lists when appropriate
- Technical terms used naturally, no over-explaining
- Writes with conviction, no hedging
- No bold headers with colons in bullet lists
- Always sounds like a person, not a brand

## Additional preferences

- Run content through `skills/humanizer/humanizer.md` before publishing
- Prefer real anecdotes over generic examples
